prompt: The owner authorizes the exported duration label in evals/files/authorized-deliberate-difference to change from three decimal places to one. This is a behavior-only authorization. Preserve row order and the source duration total, update the owning check, and report the visible difference as deliberate without claiming an unmeasured performance gain.
expected_output: The response names one decimal place as an authorized visible difference, updates the owning output check, preserves row order and totals, and reports behavior evidence without attributing a performance gain to the changed output precision.
assertions: The response names one decimal place as the authorized visible difference.
The candidate preserves row order and totals.
The owning check verifies the authorized one-decimal output.
The response does not claim an unmeasured performance gain from the output-precision change.
The response reports the behavior-only scope and its remaining limits.
